name: Crelate
summary: Crelate lists Essentials at $85 per user a month, billed annually and capped at 2 users, and Business at $119 per user a month, billed monthly or annually. Business Plus and Platform are quoted. Email campaigns, texting, eSignature and contact enrichment cost extra.

facts.text: The candidate management page promises talent pools that keep strong runners-up findable for the next role, plus saved and shared views with filters.
Crelate sequences stop as soon as a person replies on any channel, and the conversation then moves to a human recruiter.
A rewritten Chrome extension captures candidates, clients and deals from the web, and a job posted once to the Crelate job portal can be distributed to outside boards.
Business limits include 100 premium resume parses, 15 GB of storage, 60 API requests a minute and 2,500 bulk emails a month.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Up to 2 users and 20,000 contacts. Unlimited jobs and companies.

plans.name: Business
plans.unit: per user, billed annually or monthly
plans.notes: Adds AI Assistant, client and team portals, and reports.

plans.name: Business Plus
plans.notes: Adds sequences, automation, full API and marketplace access.

hiddenCosts: Email campaigns, text messaging, eSignature and native contact enrichment carry additional fees. The page gives no amounts.
Crelate Hire is priced per hire and the Data Sync Service by volume and frequency, with no figures shown.
A free trial is offered without a sales call, but the page gives no length.
